understand.concept: Learn the core concepts, vocabulary, requirements and practical use of Exception Basics: try, throw and catch.
understand.whyItMatters: Exception Basics: try, throw and catch helps learners build reliable and maintainable C++ programs while understanding trade-offs and common mistakes.
understand.explain: Study the examples and review relevant headers, types, object lifetime, error behavior, complexity and C++ standard compatibility. Snippets are illustrative rather than complete programs. Compile and test them in the intended environment.
